context.title: Report Description
context.description: The scope of the report: the first and last day of the reporting period, and a respondent category when the data cover only some participants (for example one profession).

context.title: Activity Description
context.description: The educational activity evaluated: its Healthcare LOM description and identifier, the credits it offers, whether it is designed to change competence, performance or patient outcomes and whether changes were measured, and its commercial support, income and expenses.

context.title: Participation Metrics
context.description: How many clinicians were targeted, registered, completed the activity and received credit, the credits awarded per type of credit, web statistics and the participants by category, profession and specialty.

context.title: Participant Activity Evaluation
context.description: How participants evaluated the activity: each survey question with the number of respondents per response (yes/no, scale, multiple choice) or the free text responses, and comparison data of related questions asked at different times. Source and id refer to standardized survey items.

context.title: Knowledge Assessment
context.description: Multiple choice assessment items with their responses, which are correct and how many learners chose them, and assessment scores (one score per learner, with the score method and the timing).

context.title: Extensible Information
context.description: XtensibleInfo: elements of other namespaces defined by the organization implementing the standard, edited on the XML page.

context.title: Survey Items
context.description: Each survey item: its question, source and id, and its response structure (yes/no, a scale of 3 to 10 labelled points, multiple choice select one or many, or free text) with identified responses.

context.title: Comparisons
context.description: Sets of related survey items, such as expectations before and perceptions after an activity, each with its intended timing (Before, During, After) and duration.
